min_cases.source: Lead PR2 plan, 2026-11-09: stop interpretation below 20 cases; README operational registry. Starting evidence bound, not measured success.

min_defect_cases.source: Lead PR2 dispatch, 2026-11-09: at least 20 real known-defect cases, plus clean controls.

min_controls.source: Lead PR2 dispatch, 2026-11-09: at least three clean/no-defect controls.

confidence.source: Lead PR2 plan, 2026-11-09; statsmodels proportion_confint(method=wilson, alpha=0.05), https://www.statsmodels.org/stable/generated/statsmodels.stats.proportion.proportion_confint.html, read 2026-11-09.

max_wilson_half_width.source: Lead PR2 plan, 2026-11-09: stop interpretation when Wilson half-width exceeds 15 percentage points. An uncalibrated reporting bound, never a merge gate.
